probes.contract_source: The public environment contract treats an unknown tool call as an error response with no state mutation; replay must preserve the same terminal state.
Every result marked exact_match must be compared by value regardless of the number of calls in the graded response.
Spreadsheet freeze semantics are defined by the frozen row and column split; scrolling changes the visible top-left cell but not the freeze operation.
A task's declared reward basis defines the components that the comprehensive evaluator must score; selecting the default comprehensive entry point must not omit a declared component.
A tool declared read-only may return information but must not change the database state used for environment grading.
JSON integer and whole-valued floating-point spellings denote the same documented numeric amount and therefore must produce the same deterministic graded state.
A stored full-duplex simulation is represented by ticks and a full-duplex mode marker; offline rescoring must evaluate that representation under the same communication mode as live grading.
Offline rescoring of a historical trajectory must preserve its tool-induced terminal state when only the recorded tool-result rendering has drifted.

A JSON Schema number admits both integer and fractional JSON number encodings, so replacing a whole-valued float with its numerically equal integer spelling must not change the verdict for an already produced float argument.
A function-calling evaluator must preserve a model-produced argument type until validation; it must not turn a numeric argument into a contract-valid string and thereby create a false accept.
Single- and double-quoted JavaScript string literals denote the same string value, so parsing either valid surface form into a function call must yield the same semantic parameter.
Relative time in an evaluated desktop environment is anchored to that environment's local clock unless the task explicitly supplies another timezone.
Two task suites evaluated sequentially in one worker must resolve imports from their own task directories and receive the same verdicts as isolated execution.
An absent optional helper artifact must not force failure when the same open-workspace state is available through the environment's persistent workspace metadata.
